name: Zoho Books
description: Let your AI work in Zoho Books: look up and manage customers, vendors and items, create, email, mark as sent and void invoices, create estimates, record customer payments, bills and expenses, and read the chart of accounts, account ledgers and bank transactions. Any Zoho data center, Zoho OAuth sign-in.
instructions:
## Zoho Books
This connector works with one Zoho Books organization through the **Zoho Books API v3** (`https://www.zohoapis.<region>/books/v3`): organizations, contacts (customers and vendors), items, invoices, estimates, customer payments, bills, expenses, the chart of accounts with account transactions, bank accounts and bank transactions, and taxes. It runs as the Zoho user who authorized it, within that user's role.

**Data center first.** Zoho keeps each account in one data center, and the sign-in server and API host must be that data center's:

| Region (your Zoho URL) | `ZOHO_BOOKS_ACCOUNTS_URL` | `ZOHO_BOOKS_API_URL` |
|---|---|---|
| EU (books.zoho.eu) | https://accounts.zoho.eu | https://www.zohoapis.eu |
| US (books.zoho.com) | https://accounts.zoho.com | https://www.zohoapis.com |
| India (zoho.in) | https://accounts.zoho.in | https://www.zohoapis.in |
| Australia (zoho.com.au) | https://accounts.zoho.com.au | https://www.zohoapis.com.au |
| Japan (zoho.jp) | https://accounts.zoho.jp | https://www.zohoapis.jp |
| Canada (zohocloud.ca) | https://accounts.zohocloud.ca | https://www.zohoapis.ca |
| Saudi Arabia (zoho.sa) | https://accounts.zoho.sa | https://www.zohoapis.sa |
| UAE (zoho.ae) | https://accounts.zoho.ae | https://www.zohoapis.ae |
| China (zoho.com.cn) | https://accounts.zoho.com.cn | https://www.zohoapis.com.cn |

The address bar when you use Zoho Books tells you the region. Signing in at the wrong one fails with `invalid_client` or an empty organization list.

**Setup (about 10 minutes)**
1. Open the Zoho API Console at https://api-console.zoho.com, signed in with your Zoho account → **Add Client** → **Server-based Applications**.
2. Name it (for example "AnythingMCP"), homepage URL your company site, and **Authorized Redirect URI** `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud, or `<your AnythingMCP URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself. Create it and copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** into `ZOHO_BOOKS_CLIENT_ID` and `ZOHO_BOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET`. If your Books organization lives in another data center than the one the console opened in, enable that data center on the client's **Settings** tab (Multi-DC) and use the client secret shown there for it.
3. Set `ZOHO_BOOKS_ACCOUNTS_URL` and `ZOHO_BOOKS_API_URL` from the table.
4. Find the **organization ID**: in Zoho Books click the organization name (top right) → **Manage Organizations**; the ID is shown next to each organization. Paste it into `ZOHO_BOOKS_ORGANIZATION_ID`.
5. Install, then click **Authorize with Provider** on the connector page and approve the requested access. Run `zoho_books_list_organizations` and check that the organization ID is listed.

**Scopes**: `ZohoBooks.settings.ALL,ZohoBooks.contacts.ALL,ZohoBooks.invoices.ALL,ZohoBooks.estimates.ALL,ZohoBooks.customerpayments.ALL,ZohoBooks.bills.ALL,ZohoBooks.expenses.ALL,ZohoBooks.accountants.READ,ZohoBooks.banking.READ`. Items, taxes and organization settings fall under `ZohoBooks.settings`, the chart of accounts under `ZohoBooks.accountants`. For a read-only setup, change every `.ALL` to `.READ` in the connector's OAuth settings, authorize again and switch off the create, update, email, status and delete tools.

**Tokens**: access tokens last one hour and are renewed automatically with the stored refresh token, which does not expire unless revoked. Zoho keeps at most 20 refresh tokens per user and client: authorizing the same client a 21st time (in AnythingMCP or elsewhere) silently revokes the oldest one.

**Writes are real: confirm first.** `zoho_books_email_invoice` emails the customer from your organization, `zoho_books_mark_invoice_sent` and `zoho_books_void_invoice` change the books (void keeps the invoice but zeroes it), and `zoho_books_create_customer_payment`, `zoho_books_create_bill` and `zoho_books_create_expense` post to the ledger. Say what will be booked or sent and wait for the user's yes. The delete tools (contacts, invoices, estimates, customer payments, bills, expenses) are installed switched off.

**Ids and lists**: every record has a numeric string id (`contact_id`, `invoice_id`, ...). List tools return up to 200 records per page and `page_context.has_more_page`; filter with `search_text`, `status`, `filter_by` and dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Look up `customer_id` with `zoho_books_list_contacts` (`contact_type: customer`), `item_id` with `zoho_books_list_items`, `account_id` (expense, income, bank and cash accounts) with `zoho_books_list_chart_of_accounts`, and `tax_id` with `zoho_books_list_taxes`.

**Invoices**: `zoho_books_create_invoice` creates a draft numbered by the organization's auto-numbering; `send: true` emails it at once. Then `zoho_books_mark_invoice_sent` (no email) or `zoho_books_email_invoice`. A customer payment is recorded with `zoho_books_create_customer_payment` and applied to invoices via `invoices: [{"invoice_id", "amount_applied"}]`.

**Reports**: Zoho does not document a reports API for Books. For totals, use `zoho_books_list_chart_of_accounts` with `showbalance: true`, `zoho_books_list_account_transactions` for one account, or the list tools with date filters.

**Limits**: 100 requests per minute per organization, and per day 1,000 (Free), 2,000 (Standard), 5,000 (Professional) or 10,000 (Premium and above); over the limit Zoho answers 429.

**Common errors** (`code` and `message` in the body)
- 401 code 57 "You are not authorized to perform this operation" or `invalid_oauthtoken`: the sign-in is missing a scope or was revoked, or the API host is not your data center; authorize again.
- 400 or 404 naming the organization: `ZOHO_BOOKS_ORGANIZATION_ID` is wrong or not visible to this user; compare with `zoho_books_list_organizations`.
- 400 with a field message (a duplicate name, an invalid value, a missing required field): the message names the field.
- 429 code 44 (per minute) or 45 (per day): limit reached.

**Out of scope here**: sales orders, purchase orders, credit notes, vendor payments, journals, projects, recurring invoices, attachments and PDFs.

ZOHO_BOOKS_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
ZOHO_BOOKS_CLIENT_ID.help: api-console.zoho.com → your Server-based Application → Client Secret tab → Client ID.
ZOHO_BOOKS_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Zoho client IDs start with 1000. and contain no spaces.

ZOHO_BOOKS_ORGANIZATION_ID.label: Organization ID
ZOHO_BOOKS_ORGANIZATION_ID.help: Zoho Books → organization name (top right) → Manage Organizations → the ID next to the organization. zoho_books_list_organizations lists it too.
ZOHO_BOOKS_ORGANIZATION_ID.patternMessage: The organization ID is a number, digits only.

ZOHO_BOOKS_ACCOUNTS_URL.label: Zoho sign-in server (data center)
ZOHO_BOOKS_ACCOUNTS_URL.help: https://accounts.zoho.eu for EU accounts, https://accounts.zoho.com for US, .in, .com.au, .jp, .sa, .ae, .com.cn, or https://accounts.zohocloud.ca for Canada. Must be your account's data center.
ZOHO_BOOKS_ACCOUNTS_URL.patternMessage: Use the accounts server of your data center, e.g. https://accounts.zoho.eu, without a trailing slash.

ZOHO_BOOKS_API_URL.label: Zoho API host (data center)
ZOHO_BOOKS_API_URL.help: https://www.zohoapis.eu for EU accounts, https://www.zohoapis.com for US, or .in, .com.au, .jp, .ca, .sa, .ae, .com.cn. Same data center as the sign-in server.
ZOHO_BOOKS_API_URL.patternMessage: Use the API host of your data center, e.g. https://www.zohoapis.eu, without /books and without a trailing slash.

verifyHints.401: Zoho refused the sign-in. Check that ZOHO_BOOKS_ACCOUNTS_URL and ZOHO_BOOKS_API_URL are both your data center (e.g. .eu), then click Authorize with Provider again.
verifyHints.400: Zoho Books did not accept the organization. Run zoho_books_list_organizations and copy the right organization_id into ZOHO_BOOKS_ORGANIZATION_ID.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Zoho Books allows 100 requests per minute per organization and a daily quota by plan. Wait a minute, or until tomorrow if the daily quota is used up.

prerequisites: A Zoho Books organization (the free plan or a trial works) and a Server-based Application in the Zoho API Console of your data center, with the redirect URI below. About 10 minutes.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_organizations
tools.description: List the Zoho Books organizations this sign-in can reach: organization_id, name, country, currency, time zone and whether it is the default. Use it to check ZOHO_BOOKS_ORGANIZATION_ID.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_organization
tools.description: Read the connected organization: name, address, base currency, fiscal year start, time zone, tax settings and contact details.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers and vendors) with contact_id, name, company, email, status and outstanding receivables or payables.

search_text.description: Text in name, company, email or phone.

filter_by.description: Status.All, Status.Active, Status.Inactive, Status.Duplicate, Invoice.OverDue, Invoice.Unpaid, Status.CreditLimitExceed.

sort_column.description: contact_name, email, outstanding_receivable_amount, created_time or last_modified_time.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact with addresses, contact persons, payment terms, currency, balances and custom fields.

tools.name: zoho_books_create_contact
tools.description: Create a customer or vendor. Returns the contact with its contact_id.

contact_name.description: Display name of the contact (required, unique).

contact_persons.description: People, e.g. [{"first_name": "Ana", "last_name": "Diaz", "email": "ana@example.com", "phone": "+49 761 1234567", "is_primary_contact": true}]. The primary person's email is where invoices are emailed.

tools.name: zoho_books_update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact. Zoho requires contact_name and contact_type on every update (send the current values if they do not change); other fields are only changed when given. contact_persons replaces the list.

contact_name.description: Display name of the contact (required, unique).

contact_persons.description: People, e.g. [{"first_name": "Ana", "last_name": "Diaz", "email": "ana@example.com", "phone": "+49 761 1234567", "is_primary_contact": true}]. The primary person's email is where invoices are emailed.

tools.name: zoho_books_mark_contact_inactive
tools.description: Mark a contact inactive: it stays in the books but is hidden from lists and cannot be used on new transactions.

tools.name: zoho_books_delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a contact for good. Not possible while transactions refer to it (mark it inactive instead). Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_items
tools.description: List items (products and services) with item_id, name, SKU, rate, unit, tax and status.

search_text.description: Text in name, SKU or description.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_item
tools.description: Read one item with selling and purchase prices, accounts, tax, unit and stock details.

tools.name: zoho_books_create_item
tools.description: Create an item (product or service). Returns the item with its item_id.

tools.name: zoho_books_update_item
tools.description: Update an item. Zoho requires name and rate on every update (send the current values if they do not change).

tools.name: zoho_books_mark_item_inactive
tools.description: Mark an item inactive so it can no longer be added to new documents.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with invoice_id, number, customer, status, date, due date, total and balance.

status.description: sent, draft, overdue, paid, void, unpaid, partially_paid or viewed.

search_text.description: Text in number, reference or customer name.

sort_column.description: customer_name, invoice_number, date, due_date, total, balance or created_time.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_invoice
tools.description: Read one invoice with line items, taxes, totals, balance, payments, customer and status.

tools.name: zoho_books_create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice (a draft, unless send is true, which also emails it to the customer: confirm that with the user first). Returns the invoice with invoice_id and invoice_number.

line_items.description: Line items, e.g. [{"item_id": "460000000017088", "quantity": 2, "rate": 120}] or with a free description [{"name": "Consulting", "description": "October", "quantity": 1, "rate": 500, "tax_id": "..."}].

invoice_number.description: Own number; only together with ignore_auto_number_generation true.

ignore_auto_number_generation.description: true to use invoice_number instead of the next automatic number.

discount.description: Discount, an amount or percentage depending on discount_type.

terms.description: Terms and conditions printed on the invoice.

send.description: true to email the invoice to the customer right away (default false).

tools.name: zoho_books_email_invoice
tools.description: Email an invoice to the customer from the organization, with the invoice attached. This reaches the customer: confirm recipients and text with the user first.

body.description: Message text (HTML allowed); the template's when omitted.

tools.name: zoho_books_mark_invoice_sent
tools.description: Mark a draft invoice as sent without emailing it (for invoices delivered another way). It then counts as receivable.

tools.name: zoho_books_void_invoice
tools.description: Void an invoice: it stays on record with status void but no longer counts as receivable or revenue. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: zoho_books_delete_invoice
tools.description: Delete an invoice for good (only without recorded payments). Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes) with estimate_id, number, customer, status, date, expiry date and total.

status.description: draft, sent, invoiced, accepted, declined or expired.

search_text.description: Text in number, reference or customer name.

sort_column.description: customer_name, estimate_number, date, total or created_time.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_estimate
tools.description: Read one estimate with line items, taxes, totals and status.

tools.name: zoho_books_create_estimate
tools.description: Create an estimate (quote) as a draft. Returns the estimate with estimate_id and number.

line_items.description: Line items, e.g. [{"item_id": "460000000017088", "quantity": 2, "rate": 120}] or with a free description [{"name": "Consulting", "description": "October", "quantity": 1, "rate": 500, "tax_id": "..."}].

tools.name: zoho_books_delete_estimate
tools.description: Delete an estimate (quote) for good; it cannot be restored. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_customer_payments
tools.description: List payments received from customers with payment_id, customer, date, amount, payment mode and the invoices they paid.

search_text.description: Text in reference, customer name or payment number.

sort_column.description: customer_name, payment_number, date, amount or created_time.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_customer_payment
tools.description: Read one customer payment with the invoices it was applied to.

tools.name: zoho_books_create_customer_payment
tools.description: Record a payment received from a customer and apply it to invoices (bookkeeping only; no money is collected). Confirm amount and invoices with the user first. Returns the payment with payment_id.

payment_mode.description: check, cash, creditcard, banktransfer, bankremittance, autotransaction or others.

invoices.description: Invoices paid, e.g. [{"invoice_id": "...", "amount_applied": 119.0}]. Amounts not applied stay as customer credit.

account_id.description: Deposit-to account id (bank or cash account).

reference_number.description: Reference, e.g. the bank transfer id.

tools.name: zoho_books_delete_customer_payment
tools.description: Delete a recorded customer payment; the invoices become unpaid again. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_bills
tools.description: List bills (vendor invoices) with bill_id, number, vendor, status, date, due date, total and balance.

status.description: paid, open, overdue, void, partially_paid, unpaid or draft.

search_text.description: Text in number, reference or vendor name.

sort_column.description: vendor_name, bill_number, date, due_date, total or balance.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_bill
tools.description: Read one bill with line items, accounts, taxes, totals, balance and payments.

tools.name: zoho_books_create_bill
tools.description: Record a bill received from a vendor (it posts to the ledger as payable). Confirm with the user first. Returns the bill with bill_id.

line_items.description: Lines, e.g. [{"account_id": "<expense account>", "description": "Office chairs", "quantity": 2, "rate": 150, "tax_id": "..."}] or with item_id.

tools.name: zoho_books_delete_bill
tools.description: Delete a bill for good (only without recorded payments). Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses with expense_id, date, account, amount, vendor, customer and status (billable, invoiced, ...).

status.description: unbilled, invoiced, reimbursed, non-billable or billable.

search_text.description: Text in description, reference or account name.

sort_column.description: date, account_name, total, reference_number, customer_name or created_time.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_expense
tools.description: Read one expense with account, paid-through account, tax, vendor, customer and receipts.

tools.name: zoho_books_create_expense
tools.description: Record an expense paid from a bank, cash or credit card account (it posts to the ledger). Confirm with the user first. Returns the expense with expense_id.

account_id.description: Expense account id (chart of accounts, type expense).

paid_through_account_id.description: Account it was paid from (bank, cash or credit card account id).

is_billable.description: true if it should be billed to the customer.

is_inclusive_tax.description: true when the amount includes tax.

tools.name: zoho_books_delete_expense
tools.description: Delete an expense for good; its ledger postings are removed. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_chart_of_accounts
tools.description: List the chart of accounts: account_id, name, code, type (asset, liability, equity, income, expense, bank, cash, ...), active flag and, with showbalance, the current balance.

filter_by.description: AccountType.All, AccountType.Active, AccountType.Inactive, AccountType.Asset, AccountType.Liability, AccountType.Equity, AccountType.Income or AccountType.Expense.

showbalance.description: true to include each account's current balance.

search_text.description: Text in account name or code.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_account
tools.description: Read one account of the chart of accounts: name, code, type, currency, description and balance.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_account_transactions
tools.description: List the transactions booked on one account (invoices, payments, bills, expenses, journals) with date, debit, credit and reference: a ledger view of the account.

transaction_type.description: Only one type, e.g. invoice, customer_payment, bills, expense, journal.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_bank_accounts
tools.description: List bank, cash and credit card accounts with account_id, name, type, currency, balance and bank name.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_bank_account
tools.description: Read one bank or credit card account with balance and bank details.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_bank_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions (deposits, withdrawals, transfers and feed lines) with date, amount, type, status (categorized, uncategorized, matched, excluded) and reference.

filter_by.description: Status.All, Status.Uncategorized, Status.Categorized, Status.ManuallyAdded, Status.Excluded or Status.Matched.

search_text.description: Text in reference, payee or description.

tools.name: zoho_books_get_bank_transaction
tools.description: Read one bank transaction with its accounts, amounts and the documents it is matched to.

tools.name: zoho_books_list_taxes
tools.description: List the organization's taxes and tax groups with tax_id, name, percentage and type, for line items and expenses.
